note: GQA-1 regression pack: per injected bug, one oracle-credited 1-minimal repro with the executable check that detects it; each test fails on B1 and passes on the clean build. Bug ids are oracle-side labels (analysis only).

checks.rule: The player makes at most one move per tick: a step of one tile or a dash of up to two tiles in a straight line.
checks.expect: (cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x || cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y) && abs(cur.state.player.x - prev.state.player.x) + abs(cur.state.player.y - prev.state.player.y) <= 2

tests.title: Dash and step both applied in one tick, moving the player 3 tiles

checks.rule: The HUD always shows the current score (below 1,000), lives, keys, coins, time and dash status.
checks.expect: (cur.state.score >= 1000 || num(cur.hud.score) == cur.state.score) && num(cur.hud.lives) == cur.state.lives && num(cur.hud.keys) == cur.state.keys && num(cur.hud.coins) == cur.state.coins && num(cur.hud.time) == cur.state.timeLeft

tests.title: HUD coin counter stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin

checks.rule: Restart level puts the level back to its start: score 0, 3 lives, all items back, timer 300, and the game is running.
checks.expect: cur.state.score == 0 && cur.state.lives == 3 && cur.state.coins == 0 && cur.state.keys == 0 && cur.state.timeLeft == 300 && cur.state.mode == 'playing'

tests.title: Restart level leaves the game paused instead of running

checks.rule: Every visible button must be clickable: nothing may cover it.

tests.title: Key-collected toast covers the pause menu's Resume button

checks.rule: Every visible button must be clickable: nothing may cover it.

tests.title: Level-complete bonus banner covers the Finish button

checks.rule: Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999.
Score only drops because of spikes or a restart; items never reduce it.

tests.title: Spikes wrap the score to 65136 and then negative values

checks.rule: When pausing, the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens in that tick.
checks.expect: cur.state.player == prev.state.player && cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.clock == prev.state.clock

tests.title: Movement still happens in the tick where pause is pressed
